review:
The officially licensed Godfather game on 20 lines, with Godfather-logo wilds on every reel and three bonus modes.

Mystery symbols reveal tokens: bronze can trigger Loyalty Bonus Spins, silver Honor Hold & Win Spins, and gold Vengeance Jackpot Spins. The three-pillar idea fits the films nicely, and bonuses come round about once every 105 spins. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max, 96.57% RTP.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 105 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
